name: RMSNorm
description: RMSNorm over the last dimension: out = x * rsqrt(mean(x^2) + 1e-6) * weight. Compute in float32; inputs and output are float16.
signature: run(x: Tensor[M, N], weight: Tensor[N]) -> Tensor[M, N]
provenance: Original KernelRL task (written from scratch). Task category inspired by KernelBench level 2 (github.com/ScalingIntelligence/KernelBench, MIT license); no KernelBench code copied.
